speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe the characteristics of your postmenopausal bleeding, such as how long it has been occurring and if there is any associated pain or pressure. Additionally, do you have any history of hormonal medication use or prior gynecological cancers?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postmenopausal bleeding with an adnexal mass is concerning for endometrial carcinoma or ovarian malignancy. Given the patient's age and lack of hormonal use, I request an ENDOMETRIAL BIOPSY and CA-125 blood test to evaluate the endometrium and ovarian mass respectively.
